calibration_amendment.trigger: The frozen 16-step sequential contrast was invalid for direction because all three no-transfer checkpoint-3 workers scored 0/8 Core.
calibration_amendment.only_change: Increase the per-checkpoint MiniSWE action budget from 16 to 20 for a no-transfer headroom screen.

benchmark_isolation.automatic_clean_revaluation: Reject infrastructure failure, Core-total drift, or test-hash drift and re-evaluate the same snapshot against checkpoint 3.

selection_rule.activate_step20: At least one worker scores at least 2/8 checkpoint-3 Core and both evaluations are target-consistent.
selection_rule.weak_headroom: At least one worker scores 1/8; permit one formal step-20 contrast but require control mean above 0.10 there.
selection_rule.abandon: Both workers score 0/8 Core. Do not increase the action budget again.
selection_rule.too_easy: Both workers pass 8/8 Core. Do not use this setting for a degradation contrast.
